newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Star buys 49 pct of Russian gold project.
newsitem.headline: Star buys 49 pct of Russian gold project.

text.p: Australian minerals explorer Star Mining Corp NL said it has reached an agreement to acquire 49 percent of Russian gold company, the Sukhoi Log Mining Co, for US$50 million.
Sukhoi Log Mining has a share of the rights to develop the Sukhoi Log gold field, which has been dubbed "Siberia's El Dorado", with gold reserves of about 35 million troy ounces.

The acquisition would be made through Star Mining's unit Star Technology, which holds a 34.88 percent interest in Russian closed joint stock company, Lenzoloto, which owns the mining and development rights for the Sukhoi Log field.
The acquisition of 49 percent of Sukhoi Log would lead to a restructure of Lenzoloto.
Last month, a Lenzoloto offical said Star Mining was the preferred bidder for the shares in Sukhoi Log Mining Co.

Last November, Star Mining formed a deal with South African mining group JCI Ltd for JCI to acquire an option to subscribe for shares in Star Technology for about US$250 million giving it a 30 percent economic interest in Sukhoi Log.
"Negotiations with South African mining group JCI Ltd have resumed and are currently at an advanced stage," Star Mining said in a statement.

Star Mining said subject to formal agreement being reached between JCI and Star, funding for the acquisition by Star of the 49 percent of the Sukhoi Log Mining Co has been agreed with Standard Bank of South Africa.
Under the terms of the agreement, Standard Bank will provide US$50 million on April 21 1997 to purchase the interest in the Sukhoi Log Mining Co said Star Mining.
Star Mining said it is also arranging finance from Standard Bank for the Sukhoi Log project for no less than US$700 million.
Sukhoi Log -- which means Dry Ravine in Russian -- is in the south-east of Siberia in the remote Irkutsk region.

Star Mining said Lenzoloto has made guarantees to Star and its financial backers that the restructuring of Lenzoloto, the formation of the Sukhoi Log Mining Company, and the sale to Star of 49 percent of the Company will be completed by April 21.

It said Lenzoloto also guaranteed that all licences applicable to Sukhoi Log and the surrounding deposits will be transferred to Star Mining and will contain terms and conditions consistent with the feasibility study carried out by independent consultants Steffen Robertson and Kirsten.
At 1 p.m. (0200 GMT), Star Mining shares were one cent up at 24 cents.
